mechanism: Ramipril may increase mefloquine levels by reducing renal clearance through ACE inhibition effects on renal hemodynamics, while mefloquine can cause QT prolongation and CNS effects that may be potentiated by ACE inhibitor-induced hypotension.
action: Monitor blood pressure, cardiac rhythm, and neuropsychiatric symptoms; consider alternative antimalarial if possible; ensure adequate hydration and renal function monitoring.
